skills.name: pacing-coach
skills.description: Guide teachers through Val's four-phase OpenSciEd pacing workshop.
skills.shortDescription: Build a realistic OpenSciEd pacing plan.
skills.longDescription: Pacing Coach guides teachers and instructional leaders through a four-phase planning method: count real instructional days, estimate unit lengths, map units to dates, and deep-dive Unit 1.
skills.author: Val
skills.defaultPrompt: Use Pacing Coach to help me create a realistic pacing plan.

skills.name: openscied-resource-finder
skills.description: Find, compare, and synthesize OpenSciEd curriculum materials with grounded citations.
skills.longDescription: OpenSciEd Resource Finder searches an authenticated read-only curriculum library and retrieves bounded excerpts for grounded discovery, comparison, and synthesis.
skills.author: Eddo
skills.defaultPrompt: Find the OpenSciEd materials I need and cite the source evidence.
